rationale: The agent appeared to authenticate the user via name and ZIP and accessed the user and order details before initiating an exchange. However, there is no evidence of explicit user confirmation prior to performing the order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items), which violates the stated policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing action. Additionally, the closing message provides no concrete details about the exchange outcome (new item specifics, any price difference, return/shipping steps, or timelines), so the final information is incomplete. Given these gaps, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
